body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
qkv_rms_norm_rope_cache在aclnn侧没有把传入的epsilon从double转换成float，导致在特定场景下会有精度问题。
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
910C
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
输入的取值范围设置为[-1e-10, 1e-10]
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
精度对比通过
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
```
>       self.assertRtolEqual(q_out_cpu, q_out_res, prec=rtol)

st.py:290: 
_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 
/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch_npu/testing/testcase.py:227: in assertRtolEqual
    _assertRtolEqual(x, y, prec, prec16, message)
/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch_npu/testing/testcase.py:221: in _assertRtolEqual
    compare_res(prec16, minimum16)
/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch_npu/testing/testcase.py:166: in compare_res
    self.fail(message)
E   AssertionError: None
--------------------------------- Captured stdout call ---------------------------------
[Epsilon Debug] Interpreted as 32-bit float : 0.000000000000000e+00
[Epsilon Debug] Interpreted as 64-bit double: 1.000000000000000e+00
```
### Special notes for this issue/备注 (Optional / 选填)
